[[Electronic_Sports_World_Cup/2003|Electronic Sports World Cup]]) * SK Gaming won [[SK_Gaming/Matches/42-0_Streak|42 LAN matches in a row]] from the 13th of July 2003 till the 20th of December 2003, winning 6 tournaments in a row. * Hold the record for most [[Counter-Strike_Majors|Counter-Strike majors]] won with 6 titles: [[2002_CPL_Summer_Championship|CPL Summer 2002]], [[2003_CPL_Summer_Championship|CPL Summer 2003]], [[World_Cyber_Games/2003|World Cyber Games 2003]], [[2003_CPL_Winter_Championship|CPL Winter 2003]], [[2005_CPL_Winter_Championship|CPL Winter 2005]] and [[Electronic_Sports_World_Cup/2011/Counter-Strike|Electronic Sports World Cup 2011]]. * SK Gaming is the first and only team to win two ESL One: Cologne events and win them back-to-back - Defeating [[Team Liquid]] 2-0 in [[ESL/One/2016/Cologne|2016]] and [[Cloud9]] 3-0 in [[ESL/One/2017/Cologne|2017]]. * In 2017, the team won 8 out of 9 grand finals on LAN.
